title: Enslaved to Your Wife: First Session (ORIGINAL)
description: They told the wrong person to Love, Honor, and Obey, at your wedding. Your wife is ready to fix that, so she sent you to me, telling you it would be a simple therapy session. And it is simple, you just have to listen... And when you go home to your wife, you will OBEY. Instructions The "Enslaved to Your Wife Series" is a hypno-training roleplay of 'Sessions' that build on your prior conditioning and experiences with trance. Prerequisites for you to really make the triggers sink into your mind are "My Sweet Boy", "Slave. Obey.", "Yes Domina" and "HFO Iteration". Currently the series comprises of the following: • First Session: Into "Submission and Sleep" Your first month of chastity training. • Second Session: "Triggers" Your second month of chastity and obedience training. • Third Session: "In the Kitchen" Your third, and final months of obedience and discipline training.
author: Mistress Shibby
